confidence_notes: Meal, coffee, and draft-beer anchors use San Sebastian cost-of-living data last updated in May 2026. Cocktail and restaurant-wine prices are less standardized and vary by venue; wine is estimated from local bar price ranges. Accommodation figures are broad model estimates and vary substantially by season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on San Sebastian prices. Accommodation estimates reflect a high-demand northern Spanish coastal destination, with Bilbao as a broad regional comparison and an allowance for San Sebastian's stronger tourism and seasonal pressure.
